description: This source file defines the ModelTreeCondition class, which models a <condition> element within the widget model framework of the OFBiz project. It provides a constructor for creating a condition based on an XML element and a getter method to access the condition.

classes.name: ModelTreeCondition
classes.description: Represents a condition element within a model tree structure, providing access to a ModelCondition object based on an XML element.

methods.name: ModelTreeCondition
methods.description: Constructor that creates a ModelTreeCondition instance using a ModelTree and an XML element representing the condition.

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Returns the ModelCondition object associated with this ModelTreeCondition.
